title: Blood and skin age prediction: what survives a new cohort?
desc: Reconstructed a 2023 age-clock concept using 634 blood methylation samples and 1,798 skin microbiome samples. Nested validation, independent-cohort testing, repeated-participant audits, assay-quality diagnostics and reproducible figures. Blood plate-held-out MAE 4.21 years; skin study transfer exposes a large generalization gap.
heroCaption: Held-out age predictions, independent-cohort failures and skin study-transfer error
